note: The coin, and the wallet that holds it, is being singled out. Hollered at means it is an attack surface: someone is lining up a way in.
SHA-256 is the hash function Bitcoin mining and addresses use. Guessing keys by hashing at random is not a workable break-in.
Craig Wright claims he is Satoshi Nakamoto, Bitcoin's pseudonymous creator. The claim is disputed; in 2024 the UK High Court held he is not Satoshi.
Hashrate is the computing power pointed at Bitcoin mining, in hashes per second. More of it makes a majority of the network costlier to assemble.
A 51 percent attack is control of a majority of hashrate, enough to outwork honest miners and replace recent blocks.
A reorg replaces the current chain tip with a heavier competing chain, undoing the blocks that get swapped out.
HEX is the token project associated with Richard Heart. Bags are the coins held; the bar says that position was wrecked.
Six figures is a holding sized in the hundreds of thousands.
A short squeeze is a rising price that forces short sellers to buy back, which can drive the price up further. The bar pins that on the fiat rat race.
DPR here is Dread Pirate Roberts, the handle used on Silk Road, a marketplace that settled in bitcoin.
Ross Ulbricht was convicted as the operator of Silk Road. The bar asks who the name belongs to if he was the one left with it.
Sam Bankman-Fried ran the FTX exchange. It collapsed in 2022, and he was later convicted of fraud.
Bernie Madoff ran a Ponzi scheme in traditional markets and was convicted of fraud. The bar sets the FTX collapse beside that case.

phrase:
You were messing with the Rothschild’s
If your first name was Adolf
note: Fringe groups allege that the Rothschild banking family and a figure named Adolf belong to one story about who controls money. The bar cites that allegation.
A hedge fund is a private pooled vehicle. Bonuses are what the managers take out when the book pays.

phrase: bought the news and sold the rumour
note: Buying after the headline and selling the rumor is the late trade: the move has often already happened.

phrase: bought the rumour sold the news
note: Buy the rumor, sell the news: price often moves before the headline, and the headline is the exit.
Non-KYC bitcoin is coin held or moved without a know-your-customer identity check at an exchange.
A recession is a broad contraction in economic activity.
A collapse on Wall Street is a sharp drop across mainstream equity and credit markets.
